single.rationale: NBIX demonstrates exceptional financial momentum with 24% revenue CAGR, accelerating growth (21% in FY2025), and dramatic operating leverage expansion (operating margin doubling from 11% to 24% over three years). dropped.claim: The company has demonstrated strong commercial execution with 24.3% revenue CAGR and exceptional cash generation ($748.7M FCF, 26.2% margin), but faces two critical binary risks that warrant a 'Watch' rather than deeper engagement: (1) INGREZZA net pricing is already deteriorating years ahead of 2029 Medicare negotiation, with management explicitly citing pricing pressure in FY2025 despite volume growth, and (2) recent Phase 3 failures in valbenazine expansion studies and Phase 2 MDD setback undermine confidence in the two critical 2027 pipeline readouts (osavampator, direclidine) that represent the primary diversification catalysts away from 87% revenue concentration in a single asset. The quality of the business model is evident in operating margin expansion to 21.6% and FCF materially exceeding net income, but the risk/reward is unattractive until either INGREZZA pricing stabilizes with demonstrable evidence or Phase 3 data from osavampator/direclidine de-risks the pipeline in 2027. CRENESSITY's $301.2M first-year performance is impressive but addresses only 20,000 U.S. patients and cannot offset flagship product risk. Revisit post-2027 data or if INGREZZA net pricing trends reverse.
